themes.label: Keyword And Object Search Failure
themes.definition: Users experience failed, irrelevant, or missing results when querying specific objects, keywords, or descriptive terms.

themes.label: Face Grouping And Tagging Limitations
themes.definition: Users struggle to find people due to inaccurate face detection, missing manual face tagging, or broken person grouping.

themes.label: Broken Metadata And Timeline Scrambling
themes.definition: Users cannot locate photos chronologically because timestamps, EXIF data, or date metadata were lost or altered during upload or export.

themes.label: Missing Contextual And Timeline Browsing
themes.definition: Users struggle to jump from an individual search result to the surrounding timeline or view adjacent photos taken on the same day.

themes.label: Album And Folder Hierarchy Limitations
themes.definition: Users struggle to locate images because cloud libraries lack subfolder structures or omit search and sorting tools inside albums.

themes.label: Unindexed Or Incomplete Cloud Backups
themes.definition: Photos fail to appear in search results because backup is paused, slow, or keeping files purely on device without search indexing.

themes.label: Device And File Attribute Filtering
themes.definition: Users search by technical attributes like phone model, camera source, file type, or screenshot status when content queries fail.

themes.label: AI Search Degradation And Overhauls
themes.definition: Users report that new AI or Gemini-based search features worsen retrieval accuracy or break previously reliable search functionality.

themes.label: Manual Scrolling And Date Estimation
themes.definition: Users fall back to scrolling manually through timelines and guessing dates or locations when direct search queries prove ineffective.

themes.label: External Tools And Alternative Management
themes.definition: Users export their library or switch to third-party tools, local search utilities, or self-hosted platforms to find and organize photos.

themes.label: Deleted Photo Retrieval Attempts
themes.definition: Users search for ways to recover lost, vanished, or accidentally deleted photos from trash, cloud sync glitches, or account removals.

themes.label: Duplicate Stacking And Image Clutter
themes.definition: Users face difficulties locating specific images due to duplicate clutter or automatic grouping features combining similar photos.
